notes: Objectives are printed in one 'Objectifs' cell per theme; they are kept at theme level (topic null), not split between units. Pages 60-64 (p59 is the section cover 'Lettres'). 3 themes, 14 units. Each theme is a 4-column table (Thème | Objectifs | Contenu | Activités envisageables); the 'Activités envisageables' column (including its NB remarks) is excluded. domain = the Thème (week counts dropped), topic = the numbered unit in the Contenu column. In the tables the Objectifs column is one undivided cell per theme page (the dashed row separators run only across Contenu/Activités), so each objective was assigned to the unit it is printed beside on the page image, checked against its wording. Contents are the Contenu lines as printed (sub-headings like 'Les cellules sexuelles :' kept as their own item, bullets/dashes stripped). Theme I has full-width sub-headings 'La fonction reproductrice chez l’homme :' (p60) and '... chez la femme :' (p61), kept as a topic prefix; units 4-6 (p62) are printed without such a sub-heading. Objectives are short action-verb statements (Expliquer / Identifier / Pratiquer / Comprendre / Présenter / Adopter), 0-2 per unit. Placement calls: p60 'Expliquer les fonctions du testicule' is printed beside unit 1 but the undivided cell also spans unit 2 (Fonction endocrine du testicule); kept on unit 1 only. p61 'Expliquer la régulation de la fonction reproductrice chez la femme.' is printed beside unit 3 (may also cover unit 2). p63 the objective cell has nothing beside unit 2 (L’activité réflexe). p64 unit 3 (théories de l’évolution) has no objective beside it; unit titles on p64 carry their content in the heading, no separate items. 'mutation et élection naturelle' is printed as such (likely a typo for 'sélection'), kept verbatim.
